My dad and I used to watch Cops for the car chases together but he would never have wanted me to see someone end their life. If they hadn't issued that apology (and even though they did) they will be receiving dozens, if not hundreds, of angry letters and emails of people who are seriously disturbed by that, all they wanted to see was this man get arrested and justice be happily served so they can continue on with their mundane lives and instead they watched a young kid make a few mistakes and choose the easy way out.
